# 📁 CORTEX Documentation Cleanup Orchestrator

**Version:** 1.0.0 | **Status:** ✅ PRODUCTION  
**Author:** Asif Hussain | **Created:** January 3, 2026  
**Copyright © 2026 Asif Hussain. All rights reserved.**

---

## 🎯 Purpose

Automated documentation cleanup orchestrator that organizes the `docs/` folder, validates all links, creates stub pages for missing content, and ensures documentation consistency across master files.

**Target:** CORTEX documentation site (`docs/` folder)  
**Scope:** File organization, link validation, stub generation, documentation synchronization  
**Tools:** PowerShell automation scripts (`docs-organizer.ps1`, `create-stub-pages.ps1`)

---

## 🔀 Command Patterns

| Pattern | Action |
|---------|--------|
| `cleanup docs`, `organize docs` | Run full cleanup pipeline |
| `validate docs`, `check docs` | Validation only (dry run) |
| `create stubs`, `generate stubs` | Stub page generation only |
| `sync docs`, `update sitemap` | Sync documentation master files |

---

## 🚀 Orchestration Pipeline

### Phase 1: Pre-Flight Validation ✈️

**Purpose:** Analyze current state before making changes

**Steps:**
1. Count total HTML files in `docs/` (exclude `archives/`, `cortex-lens-output/`)
2. Run `docs-organizer.ps1 -DryRun` to preview:
   - Orphaned files (not linked from any page)
   - Broken links (links to non-existent files)
   - Missing CSS/JS/Images
   - Existing stub pages
3. Generate validation report showing:
   - Total files analyzed
   - Files that will be archived
   - Links that need fixing
   - Stubs that will be created

**Output:** `cortex-brain/documents/reports/docs-cleanup-{timestamp}.json`

**Tools:**
```powershell
.\cortex-toolkit\docs-organizer.ps1 -DryRun
```

**Success Criteria:**
- JSON report generated
- No script errors
- Dry run shows expected changes

---

### Phase 2: File Organization 📦

**Purpose:** Move orphaned files to archives, preserve linked content

**Steps:**
1. Run `docs-organizer.ps1` (live mode, no `-DryRun`)
2. Archive orphaned files to `docs/archives/cleanup-{timestamp}/`
3. Preserve stub pages (auto-detected via content markers)
4. Keep all files linked from `docs/index.html` hierarchy

**Stub Detection Markers:**
- `stub-container` class
- "under construction" text
- "Auto-generated by CORTEX Toolkit Manager"
- "Page Status.*Placeholder" regex

**Archive Exclusions (never archived):**
- `docs/index.html`
- `docs/faq.html`
- `docs/sitemap.html`
- `docs/search-index.json`
- `docs/404.md`

**Tools:**
```powershell
.\cortex-toolkit\docs-organizer.ps1 -Force
```

**Success Criteria:**
- Orphaned files moved to archives
- No linked files archived
- Stub pages preserved
- Root directory contains only 5 essential files

---

### Phase 3: Stub Page Generation 🚧

**Purpose:** Create placeholder pages for all broken links to prevent 404 errors

**Steps:**
1. Extract broken links from validation report
2. Filter out external URLs and excluded patterns:
   - `archives/`
   - `cortex-lens-output/`
   - `prototypes/home-redesign/`
   - `technical/orchestrators/`
   - `orchestrators/planning-v5/` (subdirectories)
3. Run `create-stub-pages.ps1` to generate professional stub HTML pages
4. Each stub includes:
   - Glassmorphism v4.1.1 styling
   - "Coming Soon" message with pulse animation
   - Category-based icons and colors
   - Back link to appropriate hub/index
   - Auto-generated metadata

**Stub Template Structure:**
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>{Page Title}</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="{../../}styles/main.css?v=2026-01-03">
    <!-- Responsive CSS paths based on folder depth -->
</head>
<body>
    <div class="stub-container">
        <div class="stub-icon">{Icon}</div>
        <h1>{Title}</h1>
        <p class="status">🚧 Under Construction</p>
        <div class="metadata">
            <p><strong>Category:</strong> {Category}</p>
            <p><strong>Page Status:</strong> Placeholder</p>
        </div>
        <a href="{back-link}" class="back-link">← Back to {Hub}</a>
    </div>
</body>
</html>
```

**Tools:**
```powershell
.\cortex-toolkit\create-stub-pages.ps1
```

**Success Criteria:**
- All broken links have stub pages created
- Stubs follow glassmorphism design standards
- CSS paths resolve correctly based on depth
- Back links navigate to appropriate hubs

---

### Phase 4: Link Validation 🔗

**Purpose:** Verify all links resolve correctly after cleanup + stub creation

**Steps:**
1. Re-run `docs-organizer.ps1 -DryRun` post-cleanup
2. Verify broken links count decreased significantly
3. Remaining broken links should be:
   - Stub → future content (legitimate WIP)
   - External references (ignored)
4. Generate final validation report

**Acceptable Broken Links:**
- Stub pages linking to planned future pages
- External documentation references
- Archived story chapters (pending restoration)

**Tools:**
```powershell
.\cortex-toolkit\docs-organizer.ps1 -DryRun
```

**Success Criteria:**
- No broken links to files that should exist
- All stub → stub links are legitimate WIP
- CSS/JS/Image validation passes
- Final report shows improvement from Phase 1

---

### Phase 5: Documentation Synchronization 📝

**Purpose:** Ensure all master documentation files reflect actual state

**Files to Sync:**
1. `cortex-brain/documents/planning/active/cortex-documentation/artifacts/docs-sitemap.md`
2. `cortex-brain/documents/standards/glassmorphism-design-standard.md`
3. `cortex-brain/documents/planning/active/cortex-documentation/00-master-plan.md`
4. `cortex-brain/documents/planning/active/cortex-documentation/artifacts/level1-specs/core/executive-summary.md`

**Synchronization Checklist:**

#### ✅ docs-sitemap.md
**Update (if changed):**
- Total HTML files count
- Stub pages created count
- Archived files count
- Progress summary per category
- Key achievements section
- Next actions (priorities)

**⚠️ CRITICAL NOTE:**
`docs-sitemap.md` is a **VISUAL TOOL ONLY** — it shows node structure starting from Home (root) displaying the site hierarchy. It is NOT meant for status updates. Use it to understand the documentation tree structure, not to track implementation progress.

#### ✅ glassmorphism-design-standard.md
**Update (if changed):**
- Scope section (7 feature tiles + 3 multi-panel tiles)
- Architecture pages count (active vs archived vs stubs)
- Security panel pages count
- Orchestrators panel pages count
- Current state statistics
- Cache-busting versions

**Version Rules:**
- Increment patch version (e.g., 4.1.1 → 4.1.2) for scope updates
- Update "Last Updated" date
- Add sync note in "Latest Updates" section

#### ✅ 00-master-plan.md
**Update (if changed):**
- Total HTML files (active + stubs)
- Level 1 status (should always be 62/62 = 100%)
- Level 2 status (implemented vs stubs)
- Standard tiles scope
- Multi-panel tiles scope
- Version and sync status

#### ✅ executive-summary.md
**Update (if changed):**
- Page status summary table
- Implementation priorities
- Completion status by multi-panel
- Security/Orchestrators/STS page counts

**Consistency Validation:**
- All 4 files show same total file counts
- All 4 files show same stub page counts
- All 4 files show same completion percentages
- No references to archived files (unless marked "archived")
- No references to "missing" files (should be "stubs")

**Success Criteria:**
- All 4 files updated with current state
- No conflicting information across files
- Versions incremented appropriately
- "Last Updated" dates match

---

### Phase 6: Final Validation Report 📊

**Purpose:** Generate comprehensive report of all changes

**Report Sections:**
1. **Validation Statistics**
   - Total HTML files (before → after)
   - Active pages count
   - Stub pages count
   - Archived files count
   - Broken links (before → after)
   - Missing assets (CSS/JS/Images)

2. **Consistency Check**
   - docs-sitemap.md status
   - glassmorphism-design-standard.md version + status
   - 00-master-plan.md version + status
   - executive-summary.md status
   - All files synced? (Yes/No)

3. **Next Actions**
   - Priority 1 tasks (HIGH)
   - Priority 2 tasks (MEDIUM)
   - Priority 3 tasks (LOW)

**Output Format:**
```powershell
========================================
📊 DOCUMENTATION CONSISTENCY REPORT
========================================

📁 Validation Statistics:
  Total HTML Files: {count}
  Active Pages: {count}
  Stub Pages: {count}
  Archived Files: {count}
  Broken Links: {count} (many stub→future content)
  Missing Images: {count}

✅ Consistency Check:
  1. docs-sitemap.md - ✅ SYNCED ({date})
  2. glassmorphism-design-standard.md v{version} - ✅ SYNCED ({date})
  3. 00-master-plan.md v{version} - ✅ SYNCED ({date})
  4. executive-summary.md v{version} - ✅ SYNCED ({date})

========================================
✅ ALL DOCUMENTATION FILES CONSISTENT
========================================
```

## 🛠️ Tools Reference

### docs-organizer.ps1

**Location:** `cortex-toolkit/docs-organizer.ps1`  
**Version:** Enhanced with stub detection + comprehensive validation  
**Lines:** 611

**Key Functions:**
- `Get-AllHtmlFiles` - Recursively find all HTML files
- `Test-IsStubPage` - Detect stub pages via content markers
- `Get-LinksInFile` - Extract HTML/CSS/JS/Image links
- `Build-LinkGraph` - Create dependency graph
- `Resolve-RelativePath` - Handle ../ and ./ paths
- `Update-LinksInFile` - Rewrite links after moves

**Parameters:**
- `-DryRun` - Preview changes without executing
- `-Force` - Execute cleanup without confirmation

**Output:** JSON report in `cortex-brain/documents/reports/`

**Bug Fixes Applied:**
- Path resolution uses `Resolve-Path` (not `Join-Path` with `..`)
- Test-Path uses `-LiteralPath` for special characters
- Stub detection prevents accidental deletion

---

### create-stub-pages.ps1

**Location:** `cortex-toolkit/create-stub-pages.ps1`  
**Version:** 1.0.0  
**Lines:** 300+

**Key Functions:**
- `Get-PageTitle` - Convert filepath to Title Case
- `Get-CategoryFromPath` - Extract domain category
- `Get-BackLink` - Determine hub navigation
- `New-StubHtmlPage` - Generate complete HTML stub

**Stub Categories:**
- WIP Level 2 Modules (knowledge/*/modules)
- Architecture pages
- Features pages
- Security pages
- Getting Started pages
- Story pages
- Orchestrators pages

**Exclusion Patterns:**
- `archives/`
- `cortex-lens-output/`
- `prototypes/home-redesign/`
- `technical/orchestrators/`
- `orchestrators/planning-v5/*/` (subdirectories)

**Output:** Stub HTML files with glassmorphism styling

## 🛡️ Brain Protection (SKULL)

### HOLISTIC_DISCOVERY
**Rule:** Search before create to prevent duplication

**Application:**
- Before creating stub, check if page exists (archived or active)
- Before moving file, verify destination doesn't exist
- Before updating links, verify target file exists

### REFACTOR_CLEANUP
**Rule:** Remove orphaned/duplicate code

**Application:**
- Archive orphaned HTML files
- Remove duplicate stubs (if created by mistake)
- Clean up broken symbolic links

### GIT_ISOLATION
**Rule:** CORTEX code never commits to user repos

**Application:**
- All scripts in `cortex-toolkit/`
- All reports in `cortex-brain/documents/reports/`
- Archives in `docs/archives/cleanup-{timestamp}/`

### PLANNING_ISOLATION
**Rule:** Documentation updates never trigger implementation

**Application:**
- Updating docs-sitemap.md doesn't implement missing pages
- Creating stubs doesn't implement real content
- Syncing master files doesn't create features
